summary: Acer Aspire 5 14 (Model: A514-54G-F4JH) is a budget-friendly laptop with limitations due to integrated graphics and thermal throttling issues. It offers a balance of performance and affordability but may experience lag or slowdowns for photo editing, graphic design, video editing, and gaming.
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling (due to high processor usage and inadequate cooling system) and Potential for BSOD (Blue Screen of Death) due to driver or BIOS issues
suggested_solution: Upgrade to a laptop with dedicated graphics, such as an NVIDIA GeForce or AMD Radeon graphics card, and increase the RAM from 8GB to 16GB or more.
